name: Kothalipi v0.1.7
body:
## What's New in Kothalipi v0.1.7

- **Natural Banglish Code-Switching (Default ON):** Speak Bangla with English words or technical terms mixed in, and Kothalipi keeps English words in proper English script automatically (toggleable in Settings).
- **App-Aware Tone & Formatting:** Automatically adapts tone to the active app — casual Banglish in WhatsApp/Messenger/Slack, formal & polished in Mail/Outlook/Docs, and technical developer prompts in Cursor/VS Code/Terminal.
- **Context-Aware Vibe Coding Mode:** Speak in Bangla or Banglish and output crisp, structured English developer prompts ready for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Terminal.
- **Voice Snippets (Quick Triggers):** Define Bangla or English spoken shortcuts (e.g., `আমার ইমেইল` or `meeting link`) to instantly expand full emails, addresses, or links offline or online.
- **Bangla-English Personal Dictionary:** Save custom names, brands, and technical terms once — sent directly to Gemini, OpenAI, and Smart Polish so spellings stay accurate.
- **Bot-free Bangla-English Meeting Notes:** Record Zoom, Google Meet, or in-person meetings without any bot joining your call, and get structured AI summaries, key points, and action items with one-click Markdown copy.
- **Unified Bangla & Translation Settings:** Translation, Banglish, App-Aware Tone, Vibe Coding, and Smart Polish now live together in one clean card with live Gemini/offline status.
- **Dynamic Onboarding & Auto-Download:** Device-aware recommendations with a Single All-in-One model option and automatic background downloads on Continue.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Kothalipi/kothalipi-desktop/compare/v0.1.6...v0.1.7
